title: LLV-167: sixth-root arity gives classical-space index one third at the half-source point

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the single LLV-167 algorithm/configuration of proof.md recovers the full secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch, including retries, failed attempts, discarded copies and all cap aborts, charged sequential work is O(2^((167/500)sqrt n*log2 n)). The exact uniform envelope has growth index1/2 with an absolute outside constant. The actual finite branch n<2^4096 is explicit; otherwise a=ceil(n^(1/6)), r=ceil(sqrt n), ell=ceil(log2 n), m=floor(2999r/(1000ell))-10ell, lambda=ceil(3335a^2ell/10000)+200ell, kappa=ceil(log2(m+a))+3; full a-input widths and a-1 binary finishing levels are specified literally. The generic fiber instrument prefixes a-4 classical table entries, calls ENUM4 and coherently reindexes the full fiber. The proof explicitly charges variable arity, tuple fields, loop counts, full labels, gate generation, source/extraction, decoder, addressing, reset and cleanup. This is joint with all other claims for the same algorithm.

For the same LLV-167 algorithm/configuration and every N,s, peak classical allocation on EVERY branch is O(2^((167/500)n^(1/3)*log2 n)) bits, with an absolute constant. The exact uniform envelope has growth index1/3. Full-label retained tables, variable-length fiber tuples, prefix lists, heaps, variable-arity loop counters, extraction scratch, caps and streamed decoder records are included. The proof bounds storage by a fixed polynomial times2^lambda, with lambda below(3337/10000)n^(1/3)log2 n and a strict gap absorbing polynomial factors. This holds jointly with full-secret success and all other resource and error claims.

For the same LLV-167 algorithm/configuration and every N,s, peak quantum memory on EVERY branch is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant, including all variable-arity siblings, finishing levels, current input registers, arithmetic/rank/equality scratch and source/extraction ancillas. The exact uniform envelope n has growth index0. This holds jointly with success probability at least1-2^-8 and the other envelopes.

For the same LLV-167 algorithm/configuration and every N,s, all fresh source copies acquired on EVERY branch, including every failed, rejected, discarded or aborted copy, number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)) with an absolute outside constant. The main hard cap is nCcap+K, with Dbar=2^a K lambda a^m,Dcap=2^12 nDbar,Ccap=2^13 nDbar. Section8 proves its logarithm is at mostsqrt n/2 on every main input. The exact uniform envelope has growth index1/2. This holds jointly with full-secret success at least1-2^-8, both workspace envelopes and total charged work.

For the same LLV-167 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
